approval.scope: Internal TS save/runtime input and output separation;no JSON/DB/value/gameplay change. All-field validation remains required.

dimensions.A: V1 data differs from runtime:91-field original writer lacks nowMs;native JSON drops RNG methods/Map entries and encodes Uint8Array numeric keys. No hydration/validation claim.
dimensions.B: Documents native representation and timestamp absence;not a new codec or default policy.
dimensions.C: Type-only module depends on GameState;Save and tools depend on snapshot types,no runtime dependency or IO.
dimensions.D: Private recursive JsonData models only existing V1 shapes;both runtime and JSON slot producers share one public snapshot union.
dimensions.E: Type contract checked by full game tsc;no runtime test added for erased declarations.19 actual Save/parser/IDB regressions reused.
dimensions.F: SaveDataV1 and SaveSnapshot distinguish encoded data from runtime;function-key exclusion is local and documented.
dimensions.G: Two exports have immediate Save/IDB/serializer/panel consumers;no schema generator/dependency/runtime helper.
dimensions.H: Erases to export {};body proof is read-only and type failures can be checked directly by tsc.
